_comment: Frozen wire fixture: the RAW bodies the IA service (FastAPI) returns on
GET /companies/search, for the two paths that produce a different shape —
the French registry default and a country-pack market (US / SEC EDGAR).
This file is the single binding between the two sides of the contract:
response is byte-equal to it, so it can never go stale;
so a field the Python side renames/adds fails the TS build instead of
Regenerating: change the Python shape -> the pytest fails -> update this file
-> the contracts test tells you whether the new shape is contract-legal.
Identifiers are REAL public registry values (Capgemini SIREN, Apple CIK) —
no fabricated data, per project rule.
